title: Crestline Fleet Account Early-Pay Discount: Amount and Paid-in-Full Test
content:
**Clause.** On a Crestline Fleet Account, the early-pay discount is credited on the invoice the most recent remittance was applied to when that remittance arrived no later than the end of the early-pay period and, together with the payments, early-pay discounts and credit memos already applied to the invoice, leaves nothing open on it beyond the amount under an open dispute registered for that invoice and the early-pay discount itself (a remittance that already deducted the discount pays the invoice in full); every other invoice remains under the base rule. The discount is the early-pay rate in percent applied once to the discount base, rounded half up to the cent only on that final product. The early-pay rate is the program's early-pay discount percent, and the discount base is the invoice amount.

## Definitions

- **The invoice** is the fleet invoice the account's most recent remittance was applied to. Its invoice amount and invoice date are those posted on the invoice.
- **Arrival within the period.** The days of the remittance are the calendar days from the invoice date to the date that remittance was applied to the invoice. The remittance arrived no later than the end of the early-pay period when those days are no more than the program's early-pay period days.
- **Paid-in-full test.** Take the invoice amount, less every remittance, early-pay discount and credit memo applied to the invoice, less the amount under open dispute registered for that invoice (the total of the open disputes on it). The test is met when what is left is no more than the discount itself.
- **The early-pay rate** is the program's early-pay discount percent. A program whose early-pay discount percent is 0 gives no discount.
- **The discount base** is the invoice amount.
- **The discount** is the early-pay rate in percent of the discount base, rounded half up to the cent once, on that final product.

When the remittance arrived within the period and the paid-in-full test is met, the discount is credited; otherwise nothing is credited on the invoice under this clause.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, a program with an early-pay discount of 1 percent and an early-pay period of 10 days)

| Invoice amount | Remittance and arrival | Other entries on the invoice | Left after the test | Discount | Credited |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2468.00 | 2443.32 on day 7 | none | 24.68 | 24.68 | 24.68 |
| 2468.00 | 2468.00 on day 10 | none | 0.00 | 24.68 | 24.68 |
| 2468.00 | 2468.00 on day 11 | none | 0.00 | 24.68 | nothing (outside the period) |
| 2468.00 | 2000.00 on day 5 | none | 468.00 | 24.68 | nothing (test not met) |

In the first line the remittance already deducted the discount: 2468.00 less 2443.32 leaves 24.68, exactly the discount, so the invoice counts as paid in full.
